_comment: 'Instant cards you play this turn get go again' was a SET_FLAG plus a flag-gated STATIC. Nothing dispatches a plain STATIC, so the flag was set and read by nothing. It is a turn-scoped grant to every matching card PLAYED -- not the NEXT one, and not an attack -- which is what GRANT_KEYWORD_TO_PLAYED is. Arcane Barrier 1 and Battleworn are printed keywords and need no ability.
